Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities joined to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures via molregno. Filter by assay CHEMBL4513218, exact measurements (standard_relation = '='), and non-null standard_value. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
